pipeline.dataset: Dublinbikes station data and Met Éireann weather, collected every 15 minutes into the public [Hugging Face dataset](https://huggingface.co/datasets/Malavnaik/dublin-bikes-weather-marts)
pipeline.file: `ingest.yml` in the public repo [malavnaik99/dublin-data-pipeline](https://github.com/malavnaik99/dublin-data-pipeline); your browser asks the GitHub Actions API for its latest successful run
pipeline.test: Says "live" only if that run finished in the last 60 minutes; otherwise it says "runs every 15 min" and claims nothing live

tests.dataset: The Dublin bikes star schema: `fct_station_hour` with `dim_station` and `dim_hour`, built by dbt in DuckDB
tests.file: The dbt tests in [malavnaik99/dublin-data-pipeline](https://github.com/malavnaik99/dublin-data-pipeline), described on the [case study](/projects/dublin-bikes-pipeline/), step 3
tests.test: 14 automatic tests on every run: keys unique and never empty, every fact linked to its dimensions, counts never negative, freshness (newest data under 2 hours old) and volume (at least 75% of the expected snapshots in the last day); a failure sends a Telegram alert

rocauc.dataset: Civil Comments (public, CC0): 180,488 held-out test comments, 8.0% toxic, which the model never saw in training
rocauc.test: Re-scoring the same test comments for the threshold sweep reproduced ROC-AUC 0.9574 (`assets/data/moderation-sweep.json`)

dsa.dataset: 25 test questions about the EU Digital Services Act, over the official text from [EUR-Lex](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg/2022/2065/oj/eng)
dsa.file: The evaluation in [malavnaik99/eu-dsa-search](https://github.com/malavnaik99/eu-dsa-search); its saved results are `assets/data/dsa-examples.json`
dsa.test: Vector search put the right article in the top 3 for 21 of 25 questions (84%); this site recounts it from the saved results every time the charts are drawn (`scripts/make_charts.py`)
